items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: Now, I believe you made a couple of records with Maureen.

ctx.x: Yes, yes, I heard Bessie. Bessie and Ethel Waters. That was the ones that I liked the best. Oh, she was great. She was (inaudible) before then. She was great, she could sing anything.
Now, I believe you made a couple of records with Maureen.
Yeah, way back there. I think I did.
